pr_title: feat(browser download): add env option to disable progress bar in situations like CI
pr_body: ## What? Adds the option to disable the progress bar when downloading browsers: ``` Downloading Chromium 115.0.5790.98 (playwright build v1045) from https://playwright.azureedge.net/builds/chromium/1045/chromium-mac-arm64.zip 123.8 Mb [== ] 11% 10.5s^C ``` ## Why? In situations like CI , this can lead to a lot of console spam so its better to have this functionality configurable. Fixes #22074 The below is actually from this PR's Build! ( Let me know if you want me to also enable this ENV in the YAML :) ) ## How did I test this? I leveraged the `roll_browser.js` NodeJS script to verify this functionalilty. `PLAYWRIGHT_SHOW_DOWNLOAD_PROGRESS=0 node roll_browser.js chromium 1045 build` -> Doesn't show progress bar `PLAYWRIGHT_SHOW_DOWNLOAD_PROGRESS=1 node roll_browser.js chromium 1045 build` -> Shows progress bar `PLAYWRIGHT_SHOW_DOWNLOAD_PROGRESS=0 node roll_browser.js chromium 1045 build` -> Default , shows progress bar

issue_context.title: [Feature] Ability to disable progress output from install
issue_context.body: 👋 We call `npx playwright install` in CI quite a bit, and it spams the logs quite a bit with progress bars. It'd be nice if there was a `--no-progress` flag or similar like many other dependency installation commands that suppresses the progress bar printing, allowing for cleaner logs. Cheers.
comments: Working on this, testing it out and writing documentation :) https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/24352

@MattIPv4 can you help me with an example? please see this message ->

https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/24352

```
To make sure we are on the same page, we have two versions of the download progress reporting: getBasicDownloadProgress and animated getAnimatedDownloadProgress. The idea is that we use animated one whenever we detect TTY so that it was nice and interactive. And for the other cases (CI), we use the basic one.

I read you request as getBasicDownloadProgress is still too noisy, I want it to be more concise. Is that correct assessment? If so, the changes should be localized to getBasicDownloadProgress.
``` - Pavel

review_comments: There already is a special case for `process.stdout.isTTY` (line 94 of this file). I think you are seeing the results of the `getBasicDownloadProgress` here, which is as intended. Sometimes downloading will fail and it is important to see when this happens.

`isTTY` can still spam the console I think right? Current method shows an error if download happens even with `() => {}` Anyway I might be misunderstanding the original goal so please let me know if you would like me to do this a different way.

To make sure we are on the same page, we have two versions of the download progress reporting: `getBasicDownloadProgress` and animated `getAnimatedDownloadProgress`. The idea is that we use animated one whenever we detect TTY so that it was nice and interactive. And for the other cases (CI), we use the basic one.

I read you request as `getBasicDownloadProgress` is still too noisy, I want it to be more concise. Is that correct assessment? If so, the changes should be localized to `getBasicDownloadProgress`.
